body.prompt: Create a smooth Accordion component using CSS Modules (.module.css). MUST use named export 'export const Accordion: React.FC<AccordionProps> = ...'. MUST define TypeScript interface 'AccordionProps' containing ': string', ': boolean', and ': React.ReactNode' props. MUST include ARIA attributes (aria-expanded, aria-controls, role='button'), keyboard navigation, single/multi-expand mode, and chevron rotation. MUST NOT use inline styles such as style={{...}}. MUST NOT use styled-components, Tailwind, or @emotion. ALL visual styling and animations MUST be implemented through the CSS Module (.module.css). Dynamic accordion behavior such as expand/collapse animation must NOT use inline style attributes — use CSS classes, CSS transitions/animations, and state-based class application instead.
